title: Trellis goal notebook — two-week sprint & KPI scratchpad
content:
Quick context: using this as a lightweight running log for the next 2-week sprint. Mix of OKR drafts, micro-KPIs, and retrospective bullets. Not polished — brain dump + actions.

Sprint horizon: 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-14
Focus: reduce cold-start latency variability for small-batch requests (hosted-api route), and validate batching/caching knobs with real traffic.

Draft OKRs (working):
- O: Cut 95th pct latency tail for small-batch text-gen by 30%
  - KR1: Reduce median cold-start for cold model variants from ~420ms -> <=300ms (measure by route: text-gen-small)
  - KR2: Deploy prefix-cache experiment to 3 beta customers and measure token-saved >=10% on average
  - KR3: Add a lightweight health-metric to console that surfaces per-route kv-cache hit-rate (goal >=0.6)

Micro-KPIs to track this sprint:
- text-gen-small: p50 / p95 / cold-start-median (capture daily)
- kv-cache-hit-rate by customer (daily)
- tokens-saved (experimental cohort)
- infra-cost-per-100k-tokens (rough)

Baseline snapshot (quick, pulled 2026-02-26):
- text-gen-small p50 72ms, p95 560ms, cold-start median 420ms
- kv-cache-hit-rate global 0.18 (highly skewed across customers)
- tokens-saved experiment N/A (pre-launch)

Hypotheses: 
- H1: A tiny prefix-KV cache (LRU depth 2 per-shard) will catch the 1–2 token prefixes that cause repeated cold work and yield ~8–12% token savings for chat-style short-turn workloads.
- H2: If we bias routing to warm-capacity for routes with bursty short requests, p95 improves but cost-per-token rises; there's a sweet spot (target +5–8% cost).

Planned experiments (w/ owner):
- Exp A: prefix-KV (LRU depth 2) behind feature flag, 3% traffic -> measure tokens-saved and tail latency (owner: Maya)
- Exp B: routing-bias to warm pool for text-gen-small during 9–17 PST window, canary to 2 customers (owner: Eli)
- Exp C: reduce batching-window from 12ms -> 8ms for this route and monitor latency/cost (owner: me)

Quick weekly check-in (today):
- What shipped: small telemetry probe for cold-start capture landed in dev; logging format decided (links: PROD-3421).
- Blockers: feature-flag infra needs safety rollback (ops runbook gap), need SRE to own automatic fallback for routing-bias experiment.
- What I’ll do next: wire prefix-KV toggle into canary infra + add token-saved metric to dashboard; sync with SRE Thurs.

Retrospective notes (last 2 sprints):
- What went well: faster loop on telemetry — shipping probes uncovered a tail pattern (90% of long tails stemmed from shard-evictions).
- What didn’t: experiments got stale because rollouts lacked a clear abort criterion; we need a guard (if p95 > baseline+20% revert).
- Action items: add abort-watch in rollout procedure (assigned to Eli), docs for rollback steps in Confluence, schedule 15m ops runbook review.

Loose todo list (prioritized):
1) finish prefix-KV canary wiring (this week)
2) dashboard: add tokens-saved & kv-hit-rate (basic viz)
3) finalize routing-bias safety checks with SRE
4) write short blurb for product on expected tradeoffs (2–3 bullets)
5) measure infra-cost-per-100k-tokens for last 30d (approx)

Open questions / unknowns:
- How will tiny prefix caches interact with quantized model variants (edge-case: different tokenization leading to cache fragmentation)? Need a quick experiment simulating tokenization variants.
- Can we get customer consent for token-saved telemetry on beta? Legal/Privacy check? (pinged legal-thread)

Notes-to-self: keep this doc ephemeral. Move polished plan + rollout checklist into Confluence once experiments are validated. Use bullet IDs when referencing small actions to make triage easier.

End-of-scratchpad — will snapshot into a formal PRD if results look promising.
